title: Hearty Grassy Ukrainian Shrimp Fritters
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish featuring saeujeot shrimp paste, these fritters are deep fried to a crispy golden brown and served as a snack or appetizer. The grassy flavor comes from the addition of fresh parsley and dill.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the gluten-free flour, eggs, saeujeot shrimp paste, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Add the chopped parsley, dill, onion, and garlic to the bowl and stir until the mixture is evenly distributed.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter and 1/2 inch thick.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Carefully place the patties in the hot oil and deep fry for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy.
Garnish with additional parsley and dill if desired.
